content: Table TABREF11 shows the distribution of the annotated tweets. There are 1,915 offensive tweets, including 225 vulgar tweet and 506 hate speech tweets, and 8,085 clean tweets. To validate the quality of annotation, a random sample of 100 tweets from the data, containing 50 offensive and 50 clean tweets, was given to additional three annotators. We calculated the Inter-Annotator Agreement between the annotators using Fleiss’s Kappa coefficient BIBREF23. The Kappa score was 0.92 indicating high quality annotation and agreement.
